title: What happens before a message reaches chat.
juryDesc: Independent classifiers each score the message for spam and hate signals. It is only removed when they agree.
gatesDesc: Rate, shape and link checks run first. They are fast and predictable, and they catch floods and known-bad links before anything heavier runs.
networkTitle: One raid warns every protected channel.
networkDesc: A raid pattern seen in one channel is flagged for every enrolled channel, so the second target is already covered.
